evidenceNotes.source: v3 metadata and diffs/r1-vscode-73801.diff; canonical microsoft/vscode commits 0cfb9ad1 and b239497e
evidenceNotes.observation: The base is the sole parent of the reviewed head; trees match. Re-running the packet-recorded full-index command under LC_ALL=C and LANG=C produced 6496 bytes with SHA-256 a558a94c131a9176bbf4ab728c9a5b02abae12ab56f364c52489e75ad7da2c94, byte-identical to the four-section stored patch; logical stats are 4 files, 60 insertions, and 3 deletions.

The patch adds rimraf of the memoized extension-wide root after serviceExited in the server exit callback. On an unexpected exit, serviceExited(true) starts a replacement server and obtains a cancellation path before the old callback removes that root, making the replacement path stale. The token guard means the manual Restart TS Server route is less direct, but the unexpected-exit restart path is statically reachable.
